approvedDeviations.reason: Figma VECTOR child = an SVG <path> with stroke #EABB62 1.5px. Impl renders react-native-svg <Path stroke=...> which carries the same paint, but extract-impl reads CSS getComputedStyle — SVG `stroke` is a paint attribute, NOT a CSS border, so it reads as the default #e5e7eb. icon-diff already verifies the path-set is identical (figma SVG ↔ impl Path d-attribute), so this borderColor diff is the same impedance gap documented in figma-button-master 451:4629 / loading vector — applies to ALL 10 Vector children of the 5 icon frames here. Approved 2026-05-28.

Same SVG-stroke-vs-CSS-border impedance as Vector borderColor — figma reports stroke-width 1.5 as borderWidth, impl <path> CSS borderWidth is 0. icon-diff confirms the stroke is rendered correctly. Approved 2026-05-28.
